editorial.blurb: Daebak brings high-quality Korean BBQ with table-cooked meats and generous combos to a vibrant, music-filled room where the kitchen handles the grill so you can simply enjoy.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive late on a Saturday when it's quieter, or book ahead for prime times—reservations are strictly enforced. Order the Daebak combo with the gold package and don't skip the mul naengmyeon; ask for the crushed pear juice if you want a non-alcoholic pairing.
signatureDishes: Mixed platter with samgyeopsal and chadol
